objective.const: Prove one business effect per durable command identity across a real static three-member Aeron Cluster Leader failure, client UNKNOWN recovery, former-Leader catch-up, and a bounded no-quorum interval.

restartSafetyReason.const: A forced-stopped member is restarted only after a live ArchiveMarkFile activity-timestamp read observes age strictly greater than the dependency-pinned liveness timeout.

items.pattern: ^io\.aeron\.cluster\.client\.ClusterEvent: WARN - (leader heartbeat timeout|inactive follower quorum|quorum position went backwards: leaderCommitPosition=[0-9]+ quorumPosition=[0-9]+)$
